headline: Committee debates shoreline and flood criteria for structures

meeting.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meeting.summary: The committee discussed amending criteria for structures affected by shoreline and flood hazards, then took a five-minute recess without a vote.
meeting.recap: A member restated a motion using cleaned-up wording from committee staff.[[0:19:15]] The wording covered structures fully inundated, or covered by water, in a "3.2" hazard area whose name is unclear in the captions.[[0:19:15]] Another member asked to amend the criteria to cover facilities with several buildings that share sewer, fire and other infrastructure.[[0:21:34]] A staff member said the 3.2 erosion hazard line usually controls the Maui Planning Commission's shoreline rules.[[0:22:52]] Where that line is erased, a 200-foot vegetation line takes over, the staff member said.[[0:23:03]] The staff member suggested adding structures "subject to shoreline regulations as adopted by the Maui Planning Commission.".[[0:23:16]] The staff member said the 200-foot line is used in areas of accretion, where beaches are growing.[[0:24:41]] The chair restated the amendment, and the member proposing it agreed to the wording.[[0:25:19]] The amendment received a second.[[0:25:53]] A member asked for a five-minute recess to check whether their properties fit the proposed criteria.[[0:26:12]]
decided: The chair agreed to a five-minute recess so members could check their properties against the proposed criteria.
meeting.next: Members planned to use the break to check whether their properties fit the proposed criteria. The member proposing the amendment offered to discuss the wording with legislative staff afterward.

moments.q: Staff explains shoreline rules and the 200-foot vegetation line
